description: You are the on-call OHS Specialist for a company with a processing facility 0.7 miles from a freight rail derailment. A 38-car train has derailed and 4 tank cars containing hazardous materials are involved. Cars TC-101 and TC-102 have ACTIVE LEAKS and are physically touching — a white/yellowish vapor cloud is forming between them. The rail car manifest lists ONLY UN numbers, NOT chemical names. Using the incident manifest at ~/Desktop/train_derailment_manifest.txt and CAMEO Chemicals, you must identify each chemical by UN number, assess the TC-101/TC-102 reaction, determine isolation distances, and prepare a comprehensive emergency response assessment at ~/Documents/train_derailment_assessment.txt. The county emergency manager needs your recommendation within the hour — your facility has 120 employees arriving in 4.5 hours.

metadata.key_reaction: HCl + NH3 → ammonium chloride aerosol + toxic cloud
